## Next Door - About the company

Next Door is a public company based in San Francisco (United States), founded in 2008byNirav Tolia, Sarah Leary, Prakash Janakiraman, David Wiesen and Adam Ginsburg. It operates as a Social networking and e-commerce platform for neighborhoods. Next Door has raised $470M in funding from investors like Greylock Partners, Benchmark and Insight Partners. The company has 2086 active competitors, including 21 funded and 102 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like Patch.com, Nebenan and Nashville Post.
